title: Instrument observation ingress with raw checksum and quarantine
trustBoundaries: Instrument-produced bytes remain untrusted until schema, time, unit, and QC vocabulary checks complete.
Tenant-scoped message identity binds the raw checksum to one durable disposition.
failureModes: Unsupported unit, naïve source time, malformed payload, and changed duplicate enter named exception paths.
A valid QC-fail observation remains validly ingested while its scientific disposition stays reviewable.
